description: Aetox — AI agent desktop: architecture that expands any model's capability (image/video OCR, offline speech transcription, agent-driven browser)
notes: Portable build: WebView2 runtime is preinstalled on Windows 11. Tesseract, poppler, ffmpeg and whisper.cpp are not bundled with either channel; Aetox downloads them itself, only for a capability you tick (image_ocr, video_ocr, pdf_read, audio_transcribe), each pinned to an immutable tag and SHA256-verified. Speech transcription also needs a ggml model file, fetched the same way. Nothing is fetched without asking.
